recommendation.reason: With the best comparable score now 75.6% (LLM Stats, 2026-08-17), recommend needs both Real and Solid to be strong.
risks: Reward hacking and shortcuts are not discussed
Some tasks depend on remote apps needing accounts and resettable state
Aggregator best (75.6%) differs sharply from paper's 38.6%, so baseline comparability needs settling

release.quote: This repository corresponds to the **Toolathlon-Verified** final release.
